pretreatment: 50 nucleation cycles comprising a 20 s pulse of 1, a 5 s nitrogen purge, a 1 s pulse of BH3(NHMe2), and a 10 s purge
evidence: The nucleation sequence leads to separated nanoparticles, with diameters ranging from about 10 to 90 nm. The height of the nanoparticles is about 13 nm, as determined by side view SEM.
